title: Associator coherence for the fixed K-flat-normalized system scalar calculus
statement:
Fix the coefficient-derived-system calculus and its K-flat resolution coherence from [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], together with the K-flat normalized closed symmetric tensor structure of [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]; this is the fixed calculus and associator used by the scalar-extension tower, not an arbitrary `MonoidalCategory`. For the normalized scalar-extension tower data [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data], let $\alpha^{\mathrm{sys},F}$ be the associator of this fixed $F$-coefficient `systemClosed.monoidal` tensor structure. Let $\mathrm{derivedSigma}$ be the unique derived scalar/tensor comparison with the same flat-term K-flat normalization from [stage3-pur-derived-scalar-tensor-normalization]. Define $\sigma^{\mathrm l}$ and $\sigma^{\mathrm r}$ to be the two nested composites of this $\mathrm{derivedSigma}$ in the left- and right-parenthesized scalar extensions of three system objects. Then the fixed system scalar functor satisfies
$$S_{L/E}(\alpha^{\mathrm{sys},E});\sigma^{\mathrm r}=\sigma^{\mathrm l};\alpha^{\mathrm{sys},L}.$$
The associator and both sigma maps are pinned by the common K-flat-normalized tensor model; no completed integral or rational scalar square is asserted here.
